# iCartea

> > iCartea is an automotive news and review platform covering luxury cars, electric vehicles, and new model launches with a focus on Middle Eastern and global markets.

The site provides comprehensive coverage of vehicle specifications, pricing, and features for brands like Toyota, Nissan, BMW, Mercedes, and emerging EV manufacturers. Content is available in both English and Arabic, serving audiences in Saudi Arabia, UAE, and the broader Middle East region.

## Key Topics

- Electric Vehicles (EVs)
- Luxury Cars
- Saudi Arabia Market
- UAE Automotive
- Toyota
- Nissan
- Vehicle Specifications
- Pricing Information
- Electric SUVs
- Hybrid Engines
- Limited Edition Models
- Compact Crossovers
- India Market
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
- 2024-2025 Model Years
